items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: And he was playing with my band at the same time.

ctx.x: I see. And how did they sound? Did they work with you? They put my earmorphs? Yeah,

they worked with me. Yeah, they worked with me. Yeah, I used to have, when I, speaking about Biloxi, I took Marcus up there in a band we played for the Elks Convention. We was up there three days. And, because Marcus, he was an elk. See? And he was playing with my band at the same time. See? So, we were up there three days. Biloxi. Played for the Elks Convention.
